name: smwmusic-sonic-colors-somber-blue-sea-aquarium-park-act
title: Sonic Colors - Somber Blue Sea ~ Aquarium Park Act 1 (Remix)
description:
𝗡𝗼 𝗰𝗼𝗽𝘆𝗿𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁 𝗹𝗮𝘄 𝗶𝗻 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘂𝗻𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗴𝗼𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗽 𝗺𝗲!

Did an arrangement of Aquarium Park Act 1 from Sonic Colors. With all the hype surrounding Sonic Colors Ultimate / the series 30th anniversary and the remix to this theme being showcased recently, I had to arrange this song, and Jesus! This might have been my most difficult one yet, which was amazing!!

This song is beautiful. It has a calm yet sad tone with some super freaking catchy melodies to accompany it. It perfectly fits the water-type zone and is a song that'll stay in your head even after you turn off that Wii console. It also brings brings back memories of me buying this game (along with Kirby's Epic Yarn) as a kid and spending hours on both games. I still love this game a ton and was my first introduction to the boost formula games.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi, P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.
